preconditions.expression: isinstance(G, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in G)
preconditions.description: G is a list of lists representing the matrix.

preconditions.expression: len(G) >= 1 and all(len(row) == len(G[0]) for row in G) and len(G[0]) >= 1
preconditions.description: G is a non-empty rectangular matrix with M rows (applicants) and N columns (jobs).

preconditions.expression: all(cell in (0, 1) for row in G for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Every entry in G is either 0 or 1, where 1 indicates interest and 0 indicates no interest.
The number of applicants M and jobs N are between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, int) and return_value >= 0 and return_value <= min(len(G), len(G[0]))
postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer not exceeding the number of applicants or jobs.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max([len(match) for match in [[(i, j) for i in range(len(G)) for j in range(len(G[0])) if G[i][j] == 1] for _ in [1]] if all(G[i][j] == 1 for i, j in match) and len(set(i for i, j in match)) == len(match) and len(set(j for i, j in match)) == len(match)])
postconditions.description: The return value equals the maximum size of a matching where each selected pair (i, j) has G[i][j] == 1, no applicant i is repeated, and no job j is repeated.
